method.elapsed: time elapsed = (inspection date - construction start on the register) / (registered completion date - construction start); the registration date is used when no start date is printed
method.gap: gap = % built at the inspection - % of time elapsed at the same date, in percentage points; behind = gap below -10 points; past = the inspection is after the registered completion date and the project is not at 100%
method.limits: Construction does not progress in a straight line (slow start, faster structure, slow finishing), so a linear pace from an early reading tends to give later dates than the work will need, and a late reading can give earlier ones. The register % is the DLD inspection figure, not ours. A projection, not a promise and not a finding about the developer.
method.projection: only for 10% to 99% built: remaining % / observed pace, where pace = % built per day since the start date, since the registration date, and between the last two inspections we hold (when it rose); the range is the earliest and latest of these estimates
